repos.description: A simple Python Pydantic model for Honkai: Star Rail parsed data from the Mihomo API.
repos.summary_zh: mihomo 是一个专为《崩坏：星穹铁道》设计的 Python Pydantic 数据模型库，提供对 Mihomo API 解析数据的强类型支持与自动补全。支持 V1/V2 两种数据格式，内置工具函数处理角色去重与数据合并，并提供 JSON 和 Pickle 持久化方案，显著提升游戏数据集成开发效率。
repos.summary_en: mihomo is a Python Pydantic model library designed for Honkai: Star Rail, offering strongly-typed data structures and autocompletion support for parsed data from the Mihomo API. It supports both V1 and V2 data formats, includes utility functions for character deduplication and data merging, and provides JSON/Pickle persistence options, greatly enhancing game data integration workflows.

repos.description: Lovely console emulator package for Windows
repos.summary_zh: Cmder 是一款专为 Windows 设计的轻量级终端模拟器，基于 ConEmu 深度优化，集成 Monokai 配色、clink 增强命令行及自定义提示符。其核心优势在于完全便携性，无外部依赖，支持 USB 存储或云同步，内置 wget、curl、git 等工具，适合开发者随时随地高效使用命令行环境。
repos.summary_en: Cmder is a portable console emulator for Windows, built on ConEmu with major enhancements including Monokai color scheme, clink integration, and customizable prompts. It offers zero external dependencies, ideal for USB drives or cloud storage, and includes tools like wget, curl, and git for seamless command-line productivity.

repos.description: Development at the speed of light
repos.summary_zh: SpacetimeDB 是一个基于 Rust 构建的分布式数据库系统，专为实时应用设计，支持边缘计算与区块链集成。它通过去中心化架构实现毫秒级数据同步，适用于游戏、物联网和去中心化应用，提供高可用性与强一致性。
repos.summary_en: SpacetimeDB is a distributed database system built in Rust, designed for real-time applications with edge computing and blockchain integration. It enables millisecond-scale data synchronization via a decentralized architecture, ideal for gaming, IoT, and decentralized apps, offering high availability and strong consistency.

repos.summary_zh: 本项目是一个基于 Python 的微信小游戏《跳一跳》自动化辅助工具，通过图像识别技术自动识别棋子位置与目标方块，结合 ADB 控制手机屏幕实现精准跳跃。支持手动校准与自动识别两种模式，利用像素距离计算按压时长，帮助用户高效刷分登顶排行榜。
repos.summary_en: This project is a Python-based automation tool for WeChat's mini-game 'Jump Jump'. It uses image recognition to detect the player's position and target blocks, calculates the required press duration based on pixel distance, and controls the screen via ADB to achieve precise jumps, enabling automatic high-score gameplay.

repos.description: Story Creation AI Agent for novel, scripts, translation, interactive games, and IP content

repos.summary_zh: Githug 是一个通过游戏化方式学习 Git 命令的实践工具，包含多个难度递增的关卡，每个关卡要求玩家使用特定 Git 命令达成目标。它基于 Ruby 开发，支持跨平台运行，提供提示、重置和关卡列表功能，适合 Git 初学者系统掌握版本控制技能。
repos.summary_en: Githug is a practical game designed to teach Git through interactive levels. Each level challenges users to use specific Git commands to achieve a goal. Built in Ruby, it runs on Linux, macOS, and Windows, offering hints, resets, and level progression to help beginners master version control effectively.

repos.description: quick-cocos2d-x is a quick framework, based on cocos2d-x. Make mobile games in Lua.
repos.summary_zh: quick-cocos2d-x 是触控科技基于 cocos2d-x 开发的 Lua 脚本扩展框架，专为移动端游戏快速开发设计。它提供完整的 Lua 脚本支持、高级 UI 库、代码加密与自动更新功能，显著降低开发成本并提升效率，适用于高品质手游产品的敏捷开发。
repos.summary_en: Quick-Cocos2d-x is a Lua-based extension framework built on cocos2d-x by Touch Technology, designed for rapid mobile game development. It offers full Lua scripting support, advanced UI libraries, code encryption, and auto-update features, significantly reducing development costs and accelerating time-to-market for high-quality mobile games.

repos.description: [NeurIPS 2024] DreamClear: High-Capacity Real-World Image Restoration with Privacy-Safe Dataset Curation
repos.summary_zh: DreamClear 是 NeurIPS 2024 论文提出的高容量真实世界图像修复系统，通过隐私安全的语料库构建技术，实现高质量图像恢复。其核心创新在于结合 PixArt-α 生成模型与多模态对齐能力，支持文本引导修复，并在 RealLQ250 基准测试中表现优异，适用于摄影、遥感等真实场景。
repos.summary_en: DreamClear, presented at NeurIPS 2024, is a high-capacity real-world image restoration framework featuring privacy-safe dataset curation. It leverages the PixArt-α generative model with multimodal alignment for text-guided restoration, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the RealLQ250 benchmark across diverse real-world scenarios including photography and remote sensing.

repos.description: a sudoku game written in React Native
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个使用 React Native 开发的数独游戏应用，具备动画效果、编辑模式、游戏进度保存及在线排行榜功能。开发者曾创下 3分43秒的解题记录，并计划扩展多难度等级、国际化支持和云端数据存储。
repos.summary_en: A React Native-based Sudoku game featuring animations, editing mode, game resume, and online leaderboards. The developer holds a personal record of 3:43 and plans to add multiple difficulty levels, i18n support, and cloud-based score storage.

repos.description: 基于Cocos2d-X 3.17 跨平台单机麻将，商业级麻将算法、AI算法
repos.summary_zh: 基于Cocos2d-X 3.17开发的跨平台单机麻将游戏，采用商业级麻将算法与AI引擎，支持多端运行。项目代码结构清晰、注释详尽，涵盖完整的游戏逻辑、UI交互及机器人对战系统，适合C++游戏开发初学者及棋牌行业转型者学习参考。
repos.summary_en: A cross-platform single-player mahjong game built with Cocos2d-X 3.17, featuring commercial-grade mahjong algorithms and AI engine. The project includes complete game logic, UI interactions, and robot opponent systems, with clean code and detailed comments, ideal for C++ beginners and those transitioning into the card game industry.

repos.description: 创业者的游戏： 中关村启示录
repos.summary_zh: 《创业游戏：中关村启示录》是一款基于Ruby CLI的模拟经营类游戏，玩家通过雇佣程序员、管理资金与项目进度，体验创业公司从0到1的成长过程。支持自定义程序员角色、随机事件与动态交互，社区可提交Pull Request参与开发，具有高度开放性与趣味性。
repos.summary_en: Startup-Game is a CLI-based simulation game written in Ruby, simulating the journey of building a startup from scratch. Players hire coders, manage funds and project progress, and experience the challenges of entrepreneurship. It supports custom coders via Pull Requests, random events, and dynamic gameplay, fostering community-driven development.

repos.summary_zh: Deepin Terminal 是深度操作系统默认终端模拟器，基于 Vala 语言开发，支持多标签页、分屏、快捷键操作及主题定制，提供高效命令行工作环境。
repos.summary_en: Deepin Terminal is the default terminal emulator for Deepin OS, built with Vala, offering multi-tab, split-screen, customizable shortcuts, and theming for efficient command-line workflows.

repos.description: 麻将AI算法（包含全概率估算、局部概率估算、深度学习版本）
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库实现多种麻将AI算法，包括基于KNN的全局与局部概率估算、深度学习版本。核心功能涵盖听牌匹配、胡牌概率计算及最优出牌决策，支持万筒条三色14张牌判断，C语言单线程性能达6秒，Lua版约900秒，具备跨平台扩展潜力。
repos.summary_en: This repository implements multiple Mahjong AI algorithms, including full and local probability estimation via KNN and deep learning. Key features include tile matching for winning hands, probability calculation for optimal discards, and decision-making support for 14-tile games (Mentsu, Pinzu, Souzu). C version processes in 6 seconds (single-thread), Lua in 900s, with plans to optimize via color-based segmentation.
